'''Kalab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was known to be frequented by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
